scenarios: Approval record contains full company, stream, owner, agent, session, task, operation, resource, recipient and audience scope.
Amount is integer minor units and currency is a three-letter uppercase code; both null or both present.
Intent, signed-payload and signature digests use canonical 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex.
Expiry is strictly later than issuance.
Approval nonce is unique within company.
Approval ID is globally unique.
Only trusted approval service role can insert records.
Agents and model runtimes have no SQL credentials.
Owner signature verification occurs before repository insertion.
Approval record and approval_issued audit event commit atomically.
Audit head is locked and advanced transactionally.
Concurrent consumption of one approval yields at most one winner.
Consumption is bound to one unique action ID.
Consumption and approval_consumed audit event commit atomically.
Revocation and approval_revoked audit event commit atomically.
Expired or revoked approval cannot be consumed.
Scope mismatch cannot be consumed.
Amount or currency mismatch cannot be consumed.
Intent digest mismatch cannot be consumed.
Unrelated integrity/audit failure is not misclassified as replay.
Database outage or ambiguous commit fails closed and requires reconciliation.
Company A role cannot read or write Company B approval or audit records.
Audit chain is verified against independently signed checkpoints on restore.
Approval consumption eventually shares the dispatch/recovery transaction boundary.
